description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build and harden the server-side services behind a platform that runs experiments continuously, with a focus on secure, reliable and fast operation. The role is product engineering rather than research, with regular exposure to research work.
 What you'll do
 - Build and extend programmatic interfaces for a backend platform.
 - Design and scale distributed systems that run around the clock.
 - Build data pipelines that turn incoming technical literature into structured inputs.
 - Strengthen production infrastructure on a major cloud provider.
 - Write design documents for the systems you build and review colleagues' work.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Three-plus years of server-side engineering, or full-stack experience weighted toward back-end work.
 - Production experience in Python, ideally including hands-on work before 2023.
 - Background operating round-the-clock production services.
 - Ownership of production backend services from start to finish.
 - A degree in computer science, mathematics or a related field.
 Bonus points
 - Experience at engineering-driven companies or data and AI platforms.
 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform.
 - Experience building an ML or data product as a backend engineer.
 - Work on data or ML pipelines within a broader backend role.
 - Exposure to AI and machine learning.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 325,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Compensation competitive with leading AI lab packages
 - Unlimited paid time off
 - Flexible scheduling
 - Conference attendance and publication support
 Location and work model
 - San Mateo, California, United States
 - Hybrid, 4 days a week in office (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday)
 - Full-time
